title: angelica scothica
intro: Angelica scothica, commonly known as Scottish angelica, is a biennial plant belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is prized for its health benefits, including its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Angelica scothica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include furanocoumarins, sesquiterpenes, and lignans, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's bioactive constituents work together to provide relief from various health issues, making it a valuable asset in traditional medicine.
